title: Template Matching
text: Locate a template in an image, 3 inputs, 5 outputs, {Match metric} sets Match metric Sum of absolute; {Output} sets the match metric Match, {Search method}, {Output NxN matrix of metric values around best match} sets the output N -by- N matrix, {N} sets the size of output matrix, {Enable ROI processing} and {Output flag indicating if ROI is valid} sets the valid ROI. Values come from the instance.
